spans.preview: onReceivedSslError(WebView view, SslErrorHandler handler, SslError error)

issue_info.label: WebView ignores SSL errors
issue_info.description: Your application has an unsafe implementation of the WebViewClient.onReceivedSslError handler. Specifically, the implementation ignores all SSL certificate validation errors, making your app vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks. An attacker could change the affected WebView's content, read transmitted data (such as login credentials), and execute code inside the app using JavaScript.
issue_info.mitigation: Do not ignore SSL errors as it allows MITM attacks.To properly handle SSL certificate validation, change your code to invoke SslErrorHandler.proceed() whenever the certificate presented by the server meets your expectations, and invoke SslErrorHandler.cancel() otherwise.

issue_info.mitigation: Do not leave debugging enabled in the production code.
